verdict.rationale: Wise documents its own rule mechanism, Spend Controls, which automatically permits or blocks card transactions based on merchant category code or currency. That is a narrow event-to-action rule, not a general automation engine. Webhook subscriptions only push events to an external consumer that must build the logic itself, so they are a developer building block and earn no credit. Missing for 10: general-purpose user-defined event→action rules beyond card authorization, configurable actions (e.g., auto-convert, auto-transfer, auto-tag), recurring or scheduled triggers, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Control which card transactions are permitted by creating rules based on merchant category code (MCC) or transaction currency.
